question: Can you calculate the median from the highest season goals of each team?
sql:
WITH team_season_goals AS (
    -- Get goals for home teams per season
    SELECT home_team_api_id as team_api_id, season, home_team_goal as goals
    FROM Match
    WHERE home_team_goal IS NOT NULL
    UNION ALL
    -- Get goals for away teams per season
    SELECT away_team_api_id as team_api_id, season, away_team_goal as goals
    FROM Match
    WHERE away_team_goal IS NOT NULL
),
team_max_goals AS (
    -- Get the maximum goals for each team across all seasons
    SELECT team_api_id, MAX(goals) as max_season_goals
    FROM team_season_goals
    GROUP BY team_api_id
)
SELECT MEDIAN(max_season_goals) as median_max_season_goals
FROM team_max_goals
